{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-hi-x","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"ac46757e4eb14e467ef92a95038ca5b578212feae1e049bd29e124d91c378d4a","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-hi-class-3:lineage:2","source_registry_sha256":"1323c0f691f132d6e9e9a263c68306b972b82c8bbaa5a48a33a79177660764be","source_liveness_sha256":"27cf6d56fae2d5323c61bcbb69f0d992aeceb71a7dae4302b1f14baa17651cb0"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["A"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"A","chunk_id":"A.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":null,"heading":"A — Exam authority","learner_facing":true,"markdown":"## A — Exam authority

The selected pages of this section cover driver licensing exemptions, identity and legal presence rules, license types, preliminary examinations and the graduated path for minors; they list the three preliminary examinations given to an applicant, a vision test, a knowledge test on rules of the road and traffic control devices, and a practical road test, and the conditions under which the knowledge and road tests may be waived, but they state no exam name, question count, passing standard, format or time limit.

The run scope names the Hawaii Department of Transportation as the handbook issuer and the twenty twenty-three printing as the edition, but these pages carry no page-bound issuer or edition statement, so part A asserts no issuer or edition fact of its own.

Question count, passing standard, format and time limit for the class three knowledge test are not stated anywhere in this manual; every official exam fact stays unknown in this envelope and is never guessed.

Corpus note: licensing ages, holding periods and document rules are statutory facts printed in this twenty twenty-three edition with no annual-rewrite signal on these pages.
